articles.body:
Just bumping this thread because it's worth noting at least one of the fixes in the living rules for the Crown Handbook aren't included in the official FAQ in the original post or in the document not meant for public consumption linked from the original post. And if I'm reading my "edited" dates right, it's been that way for many months now.

It's deeply discouraging to come to a complex and supposedly polished game like this and to get turned around because there are multiple FAQs and errata that don't line up with each other. If Wehrlegig wants to get guys like me worked into a snit so we rebox John Company to trade it for some dumb Ameritrash with an idiot-proof rules book, they're on the right track! : )

articles.body:
[q="BitBracht"]In the topic of erratas and updates, I’d like to ask a question: the game was only now officially announced in Brazil, for release “before the end of the year”. 

Will this localized version incorporate these erratas and updates? All of them? None of them? Just some? [/q]

Most! We share the errata with our language partners. Depending on when precisely the summited their files, they will have incorporated much of the errata. However it's worth nothing that because pursued a more aggressive localization strategy with John Company (that is, localizations happened more closely to the English release), those localizations are more similar to the first English printing than if we had waited a year before starting localization.
